summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi AMD 2x Daily ETF (AMDC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD), which designs and sells microprocessors, graphics processing units, and semiconductor devices for cloud data centers, personal computers, and embedded systems. AMDC was launched on Jun 26, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
